learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the village council called the Panchayat, understand what justice means, and see why always speaking the truth is so important!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In villages, a group of wise elders sits together to solve problems. This group is called the Panchayat, and people respect their decisions.
Two friends have a big argument and take their problem to the Panchayat. The head of the Panchayat has to choose between his friend and doing what is right.
The story shows that justice is blind. You must always speak the truth and make a fair choice, even if it goes against someone you care about.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Family Court
fun_activity.instructions: If there is a small disagreement at home, like what movie to watch, let the family form a mini Panchayat to vote and make a fair decision!

quick_recap: ⭐ A Panchayat is a group of wise village leaders who help solve problems.
⭐ A judge must always be fair and listen to both sides of the story.
⭐ Speaking the truth is the most important thing, even when it is hard.
